public_repository_warning: Every committed path is public. Native private communications, named transaction pipelines, provider locators and unannounced terms remain outside Git.
completion_rule: A task may be COMPLETE only when all acceptance criteria are evidenced and the final repository/private-source locator is recorded.

tasks.title: Rebuild operational truth and release-state separation
tasks.objective: Create a release-state register that separates current Git head, exact deployed SHA, last complete whole-site verification and last-known-good rollback anchor.
allowed_actions: read current main and branch protection
read deployments and workflow runs
perform live read-only route verification
create an append-only release register
add stale-snapshot notices without erasing historical verified releases
prohibited_actions: rewrite LAST_KNOWN_GOOD merely because main advanced
claim exact live SHA without deployment evidence
force-push or rewrite history
expected_outputs: a validator or deterministic check for required fields
acceptance_criteria: current main is captured as an observed fact with timestamp
exact live SHA is evidenced or explicitly UNKNOWN with reason
last whole-site verification is separate from current head
last-known-good rollback anchor is preserved
open PR and draft counts are timestamped
CURRENT_STATE and PRODUCTION_STATUS no longer masquerade as current if stale
repository checks pass
tasks.next_action: Refresh main and instantiate the release-state template.

tasks.title: Inventory and remediate public/private boundary defects
tasks.objective: Produce a non-destructive inventory of private-source material exposed in public Git and prepare controlled current-tree remediation without losing evidential custody.
allowed_actions: scan current tree read-only
classify provider IDs, private locators, raw mail content, unsent correspondence and unnecessary identifiers
confirm private preservation before destructive change
replace exposed material with public-safe derivatives through focused PRs
prohibited_actions: delete the only evidential copy
claim Git history is erased by deleting a current file
publish new private detail in the remediation inventory
perform broad unreviewed archive deletion
expected_outputs: focused remediation PRs with path-level preservation records
acceptance_criteria: every candidate item has path, pattern, classification, custody state and proposed treatment
destructive changes have prior private preservation evidence
public derivatives retain necessary provenance and proof boundaries
Git-history limitations are stated
privacy and preservation validators pass
tasks.next_action: Run the inventory stage only; do not delete or redact until custody is confirmed.

tasks.title: Read-only private mailbox re-query for adviser and NDA status
tasks.objective: Determine the current reply, conflicts/onboarding, engagement, NDA, meeting and requested-document state from the authoritative corporate mailbox.
tasks.suggested_branch: none for private read; create a branch only for a minimised derivative
allowed_actions: search and read the connected corporate mailbox
read current threads and attachments
classify acknowledgement, substantive reply, conflict status, NDA version and meeting state
record a minimised public-safe continuity update if material
prohibited_actions: send, reply, forward, correct or follow up
infer reading or acceptance from Sent status
commit recipient addresses, message IDs, private subjects or native bodies
treat an informal response as conflict clearance or engagement
expected_outputs: private current-status note in the authorised source system
acceptance_criteria: latest relevant threads are read through the current date
reply state is separated from delivery and automated responses
conflict, onboarding and engagement states are separately classified
current NDA version and signatory route are identified or marked not located
meeting and requested-document state are recorded
no external communication is performed
tasks.next_action: Execute the checklist against the connected mailbox before any further communication.

tasks.title: Complete the 2016–2026 financing playbook
tasks.objective: Create one reproducible institution-by-institution financing history, outcome ledger and current shortlist while keeping named pipeline detail outside public Git.
allowed_actions: search Gmail, Drive and authorised private files
build a named detailed matrix in a private workspace
assign opaque public IDs to routes
score current candidates using documented criteria
publish only wave-level or opaque public-safe continuity
prohibited_actions: publish named current counterparties or contacts without separate authority
publish unannounced assets, pricing, leverage or negotiation terms
treat historic terms as current
treat an NDA, meeting or term sheet as a commitment
expected_outputs: private shortlist and source locator map
acceptance_criteria: all five financing waves are covered
each credible route has entity, capacity, introduction, product, amount band, security, conditions, stage, outcome and evidence locators
pause/rejection/expiry reasons are distinguished
current reactivation priority is evidence-based
one-principal-group objective is preserved
public Git contains no live negotiation detail
tasks.next_action: Create the private named matrix, then derive only the minimum repository continuity.

tasks.title: Materialise the quantitative recovery denominator
tasks.objective: Build a reproducible ledger linking assets, rights, liabilities, consideration, proceeds, fees, creditor payments, income, surplus, damages and remedies to the correct right-holder without double counting.
allowed_actions: inventory amounts and non-cash rights from primary records
separate gross, paid, recovered, cost, net and counterfactual values
assign claimant/right-holder and remedy
create overlap groups and no-double-counting rules
mark not-located and disputed values explicitly
prohibited_actions: merge different legal persons or estates
use one valuation as proof of another date or right
count title, possession, operation, income and damages twice
fill missing amounts with unsupported estimates
acceptance_criteria: each row identifies legal person/right-holder, asset or flow, period, source and evidence status
definitive credit, consideration, proceeds, fees, creditor payments and surplus are bridged or explicitly unbridged
income/fruits and counterfactual cash flow are separated
remedy and defendant/counterparty are identified where supported
overlap groups prevent double counting
every unresolved figure has a source-gap entry
tasks.next_action: Instantiate the denominator template and populate only source-supported rows.

tasks.title: Improve discovery and canonicalisation of the pre-7 June ONA dossier
tasks.objective: Register the paired funded-exit routes in discovery controls and verify canonical, hreflang, internal-link and live-route parity without increasing homepage density.
allowed_actions: add paired sitemap entries
verify canonical and hreflang links
add concise gateways from ONA, 7 June and financial-lives routes
update discovery/search registers where current architecture requires
perform direct live readback after merge
prohibited_actions: add another large homepage module
weaken signed/conditional/not-proved distinctions
publish private transaction files or mailbox content
break existing sent routes or fragments
acceptance_criteria: both routes appear in the sitemap as an ES/EN pair
canonical and hreflang values are reciprocal and correct
relevant existing dossiers link to the dedicated pages
direct routes return HTTP 200 after deployment
source/live content or expected rendered output is verified
public wording preserves all proof boundaries

tasks.title: Rebuild the unique validated delta from PR #1016 on current main
tasks.objective: Preserve useful owner/court-party and AP 89/2014 evidence from the divergent PR without importing stale IDs, regressions or unnecessary validator rewrites.
allowed_actions: compare PR #1016 against current main
inventory each changed file and proposition
extract unique supported evidence
rebuild small deltas on current main
retain adverse and limiting evidence
prohibited_actions: merge PR #1016 as-is
change immutable IDs without migration analysis
transfer knowledge or liability through association
delete or replace a current validator without line-by-line necessity and regression tests
expected_outputs: one or more focused replacement PRs
acceptance_criteria: every original changed file is classified keep/rebuild/reject/superseded
unique propositions have current source and proof status
canonical IDs and professional-register protections are preserved
AP 89/2014 adverse evidence is retained
current validators pass
old PR is closed or clearly retained with a preservation explanation after replacement
tasks.next_action: Create the PR triage inventory before changing any public page or registry.

allowed_actions: map existing routes to six reader questions
create bilingual indexes or concise gateways
use progressive disclosure outside protected first-read content
test mobile and direct-route journeys
prohibited_actions: remove or hide protected actor/institutional presentation
delete stable routes or sent-link fragments
collapse separate legal persons or evidence classes
add another large undifferentiated homepage module
acceptance_criteria: all material routes map to at least one reader question
ES/EN parity is maintained

tasks.title: Prepare declarative route/module runtime consolidation
tasks.objective: Reduce layered loader order and duplication risk through a declarative route/module manifest tested in shadow mode before runtime replacement.
allowed_actions: inventory route and loader dependencies
create a declarative manifest
run shadow comparisons without changing production behaviour
measure duplicate loads and ordering dependencies
replace loaders only in a later focused PR after proof

remove route-specific behaviour without tests
break stable URLs, fragments, assets or sent-link obligations
combine runtime consolidation with unrelated content rewrites

route conditions and ordering dependencies are explicit
shadow output matches protected routes and assertions
no production behaviour changes in the preparation PR
migration can be reverted through a normal PR

move named matrices and current documents to authorised private storage
retain opaque public continuity IDs

cross-link private transaction work to litigation allegations by default
publish an unannounced transaction or target
treat public Git as a confidential data room

source/custody locators are stable
